_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil's 0-for-72 statistical reality demands HOLD as the base-rate-honest call, while the analyst's Disbelief forward call is the logical next rung if compression resolves upward — but neither brain has identified a live breaker, so no directional bet is warranted.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both see a coil, but the narrative leans bullish on the analog while the analyst explicitly distrusts it; the analyst's forward phase (Disbelief) is accepted as the consensus target but only on a HOLD directional basis, not as a long trigger.
next_move.confirmed_if: Score holds 32-38 for next 2-3 windows with funding stable 0.005-0.01% and VIX mean-reverting below 65, then breaks above 39 with funding >0.015% and exchange netflow >70.
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 80 with DXY breaking 100.5 (risk-off cascade to Panic) OR funding explodes above 0.02% with exchange netflow >75 (short-squeeze breakout to Anxiety).
